payload.core_mechanism_summary: Prime factorization to extract square-free part (odd-exponent primes) as a tuple, then group numbers by this key to compute maximum group sizes initially and after one step.
payload.rationale: Adjacency is equivalent to having identical square-free parts, which corresponds to comparing parity of prime exponents—a binary representation for each prime. The code stores these odd-exponent primes as a tuple, effectively a sparse binary vector, matching the bit_binary_representation subtype.
